responses.content: There are 206 bones in an adult human's skeletal system. In the skull alone, there are typically 81 bones that come together to form a protective casing for the brain. Some of these cranial bones include the frontal bone (forehead), parietal bones (top and sides of the head), temporal bones (ear area) as well as others in various parts of the skull such as the jawbone, nasal cavity among other areas within your face that are all technically considered to be a part of our cranium.
